status: Enacted as Acts Ch. 202 with Governor line-item vetoes 2026-04-27; data center provisions removed before final passage
key_provisions: SB 197 is the state government agencies budget/appropriations vehicle bill ('AN ACT providing funding and establishing conditions for state government agencies and institutions, making an appropriation therefor, and declaring an emergency'), not a standalone data-center policy bill. House Committee Substitute 1 (2026-03-27) inserted HB 593-style data center electric-service provisions for municipal electric utilities: application/tariff process, $75,000 minimum nonrefundable application fee, 25 MW dedicated-resource threshold, prohibition on subsidizing data center customers via non-data-center rates, and curtailment-allocation rules. That language does not appear in House Committee Substitute 2 (2026-04-15), the version that actually passed both chambers, or in the final enacted bill text. SB 197 was enacted as Acts Ch. 202 (with Governor line-item vetoes of unrelated appropriations items) but contains no data center provisions in its final form.
